The System Administrator I is responsible for the administration, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure within a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment. title: Executive Assistant
description:
#### **About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.


Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.


We’re a close\-knit team of over 200 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fuelled by $105M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.


**The Role**
------------


We're looking for an Executive Assistant who can become the CEO's force multiplier. This isn't a calendar\-booking role. It's for someone who anticipates what's needed before it's asked, owns follow\-through, and protects the CEO's time like it's the company's most valuable resource, because it is.


You'll work directly with our CEO and founding team, based out of our Chennai office, with the flexibility to work remotely and adjust your hours around global meetings and time zones.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Own the calendar, end to end.** Plan and optimize the CEO's week across India, US and EMEA time zones so every hour is spent on what matters most.


**Walk in prepared, every time.** Research each meeting on the calendar and share crisp briefs on the people, companies and context ahead of time.


**Run the inbox.** Triage email, flag time\-sensitive and priority items, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.


**Be the CEO's voice.** Ghostwrite emails and posts, and manage his presence on LinkedIn, X and Instagram.


**Close the loop.** Attend meetings on his behalf when needed, capture notes, and chase action items to completion.


**Make things happen.** Coordinate events, webinars, podcasts and offsites, from logistics to follow\-ups.
  

**Support HR operations.** Pitch in on day\-to\-day HR ops, such as onboarding logistics, employee documentation, policy coordination and people\-team initiatives, working closely with the HR team.


**Handle everything with discretion.** You'll see sensitive information daily. Confidentiality is non\-negotiable.

  

  

  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


**Must\-haves**


* 5\+ years of executive\-level support, ideally to a CEO or founder
* Exceptional written English: you can write in someone else's voice
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational instincts
* High agency: you anticipate needs and act without waiting to be told
* Strong command of Google Workspace and Excel
* Comfort with flexible hours to support meetings across time zones

**Strong signals we look for**


* You've worked at a fast\-paced tech startup
* You've done research\-heavy prep or cold outreach on behalf of an executive
* You've used AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to research, draft and work faster
* You're comfortable in Notion and Slack
* You've managed an executive's social media or ghostwritten for them

**What's Different About This Role**
------------------------------------

You won't be a back\-office admin. You'll sit at the center of how the company runs, with a front\-row view of how a Series C startup scales globally. The standard is high and the pace is fast, but the upside is real: there's room to grow into chief\-of\-staff\-style or other roles as Rocketlane grows.  

  

  

  

**Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

description:
Role : Academic Sales

Cinema Factory Academy is Chennai’s premier launchpad for the next generation of filmmaking, cinematography, direction,acting, editing, and media professionals. We bridge the gap between creative passion and industry reality. As the media and entertainment industry booms, our courses are in high demand—and we need a high\-performing sales engine to turn passionate aspirants into enrolled students.

The Role

We are looking for a relentless, high\-energy Inside Sales \& Admissions Specialist who thrives on a target\-driven environment. This is not a passive counseling role; this is a fast\-paced sales position with target based from Day 1\. Your primary mission is to convert inbound leads, handle walk\-in inquiries, consult with aspiring artists/parents, and close admissions to hit our monthly batch targets.

If you are motivated by money, love the thrill of closing a deal, and want to sell something people are genuinely passionate about (Cinema!), this is your playground.

Drive Conversions: Actively call high\-intent inbound leads (generated from our social media and ad campaigns) to pitch our premium film and media courses.

Consultative Closing: Guide aspiring students and their parents through the curriculum, handle objections smoothly, and create a sense of urgency to lock in admissions.

Pipeline Management: Maintain a clean, daily follow\-up pipeline. Move leads aggressively through the funnel from initial contact to fee payment.

Hit Targets: Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly admission quotas set by the academy.

Walk\-In Management: Host prospective students at our academy campus, giving them a compelling tour that builds value and drives immediate on\-the\-spot enrollment.

What We’re Looking For (Requirements)

The Closer Mindset: Proven track record in EdTech sales, course admissions, insurance, or premium inside sales where you consistently hit targets.

Communication Powerhouse: Flawless negotiation and persuasive communication skills in Tamil and English. You must know how to connect with young creatives as well as convince traditional parents.

Objection Handling: Ability to confidently handle price resistance, timing objections, and career anxieties to close the sale.

Resilience: A thick skin and a positive attitude. You treat a "No" as just a stepping stone to a "Yes."

Media Savvy (Plus): A general interest in cinema, media, or television is a massive advantage, as it helps you speak the students' language effortlessly.

Achieving Target From Day 1

What’s In It For You?

Uncapped Incentives: A secure base salary paired with an aggressive, performance\-linked incentive structure. The more admissions you close, the more you earn.

Dynamic Environment: Rub shoulders with filmmaking professionals, directors, and artists in a highly energetic academy atmosphere.

Career Growth: Fast\-track your career into Sales Management as we expand our course offerings and academy footprint.

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

title: Server Administrator
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands\-on **Server \& System Administrator** to manage and maintain the organization's IT infrastructure, including **physical/on\-premise servers, virtual servers, cloud infrastructure, networks, storage, backups, security, and end\-user systems**.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and reliability of the company's IT infrastructure and resolving infrastructure issues proactively.

**Key Responsibilities**

*1\. Physical / On\-Premise Server Management*

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot physical servers.
* Manage server hardware, CPU, RAM, storage, RAID, power supplies, and other components.
* Monitor server health, temperature, disk health, resource utilization, and hardware alerts.
* Manage server rack, cabling, UPS, and basic server\-room infrastructure.
* Perform preventive maintenance and coordinate hardware repairs/replacements.
* Maintain server hardware inventory, configurations, warranties, and service records.
* Handle hardware failures and coordinate with OEM/service providers when required.

*2\. Virtualization \& Cloud Infrastructure*

* Manage virtual machines and virtualization environments such as **VMware, Hyper\-V, or equivalent platforms**.
* Provision, configure, monitor, and maintain virtual servers.
* Manage cloud infrastructure on platforms such as **AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud**, where applicable.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, storage, and resource utilization.
* Support application/server deployment and infrastructure configuration.

*3\. Operating System Administration*

* Administer **Windows Server and Linux\-based systems**.
* Perform OS installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and troubleshooting.
* Manage system services, users, permissions, scheduled tasks, and system configurations.
* Monitor system logs and resolve operating\-system\-level issues.

*4\. Network Administration*

* Configure and maintain LAN/WAN infrastructure.
* Manage routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, VPNs, and network connectivity.
* Manage IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, routing, and network access.
* Troubleshoot network outages and performance issues.
* Maintain network diagrams and infrastructure documentation.

*5\. Backup \& Disaster Recovery*

* Configure and monitor regular **server, database, application, and data backups**.
* Verify backup completion and integrity.
* Maintain appropriate backup retention and storage.
* Perform data restoration and recovery when required.
* Develop and maintain basic disaster recovery procedures.
* Periodically test backup restoration and recovery processes.

*6\. Storage \& Data Management*

* Manage server storage, RAID configurations, NAS/SAN or equivalent storage systems.
* Monitor disk capacity, performance, and storage health.
* Plan storage capacity based on business requirements.
* Ensure critical business data is appropriately protected and backed up.

*7\. Security \& Access Management*

* Manage user accounts, access permissions, administrator privileges, and authentication.
* Maintain firewall, antivirus/endpoint protection, and other security controls.
* Apply security patches and updates regularly.
* Monitor systems for unauthorized access or suspicious activity.
* Implement appropriate access controls for servers and network resources.
* Maintain basic cybersecurity and infrastructure security practices.

*8\. Application \& Database Infrastructure*

* Support deployment and maintenance of business applications on servers.
* Coordinate with developers for application deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Support database server infrastructure and connectivity.
* Monitor application/server availability and performance.
* Maintain development, testing, and production server environments where applicable.

*9\. End\-User IT Support*

* Provide technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, network connectivity, and other IT devices.
* Configure systems for new employees and manage IT access during employee onboarding/offboarding.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity issues.
* Maintain IT asset records and system documentation.

*10\. Monitoring, Documentation \& Vendor Coordination*

* Monitor server and infrastructure availability and performance.
* Identify and resolve potential issues before they affect business operations.
* Maintain complete documentation of servers, IPs, configurations, credentials/access procedures, backups, and network infrastructure.
* Maintain AMC, warranty, license, and vendor records.
* Coordinate with hardware, networking, cloud, ISP, and other IT vendors.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Hands\-on experience with **physical/on\-premise server administration**.
* Strong knowledge of **Windows Server and/or Linux**.
* Knowledge of **VMware / Hyper\-V or other virtualization technologies**.
* Good understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, routing, and switching**.
* Experience with server hardware, RAID, storage, and troubleshooting.

VNH Naidu Hall is a trusted, homegrown brand with an 87\-year legacy, which began with a strong foundation in lingerie and has now evolved into a complete family fashion destination. Handle customer queries through calls, email, WhatsApp, chat, and social media platforms. ● Respond to customer comments, direct messages, and queries received through social media, ensuring timely and professional resolution. ● Assist customers with order status, delivery updates, product information, size\-related concerns, returns, exchanges, refunds, and other post\-purchase issues. ● Draft clear, professional, and empathetic email responses aligned with the brand's tone. ● Maintain a positive customer experience across all communication channels, including social media.

4\. Returns, Refunds \& Exchanges

● Handle customer queries related to returns, exchanges, refunds, and product\-related concerns. ● Coordinate with warehouse, logistics, accounts, and other relevant internal teams to ensure timely resolution. ● Track pending return and refund cases and follow up until closure. ● Ensure accurate communication of return and refund status to customers. ● Escalate unresolved cases and ensure that customer concerns are not left unattended.

5\. COD Confirmation \& Customer Engagement

● Proactively call and confirm Cash on Delivery (COD) orders to reduce cancellations and Return to Origin (RTO). ● Make courtesy calls to customers when required to support their purchase journey. ● Occasionally follow up with customers who have shown purchase intent, including high\-value customers and abandoned\-cart customers, where applicable. ● Assist customers with relevant product information and purchase\-related queries. ● Maintain a helpful, respectful, and customer\-first approach during all conversion\-related interactions.

6\. Customer Support Reporting \& Process Management

● Maintain accurate records of customer queries, complaints, delivery follow\-ups, returns, refunds, and order\-related issues. ● Update CRM tools, shared trackers, and relevant e\-commerce or logistics portals. ● Prepare and share daily and weekly customer support reports. ● Track open issues and ensure follow\-ups are completed within the agreed TAT. ● Identify recurring customer concerns and share feedback with the relevant internal teams. ● Gather customer feedback to support improvements in products, services, and customer experience.

Requirements

● Prior experience in e\-commerce customer support, customer service, or call centre operations is preferred. ● Proficiency in Tamil, Hindi and English (spoken and written) is essential. ● Knowledge of Hindi or other regional languages will be an added advantage. ● Strong email writing skills and the ability to communicate clearly and professionally. ● Familiarity with Shopify and Unicommerce is preferred. ● Basic knowledge of Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, email, and customer support tools. ● Familiarity with marketplace and logistics portals will be an advantage. ● Ability to multitask, prioritise customer concerns, and manage follow\-ups in a fast\-paced e\-commerce environment. ● Comfortable handling both inbound and outbound calls. ● Willingness to learn e\-commerce order management, logistics, returns, refunds, and internal processes.

Key Traits We’re Looking For

● Empathy \& Patience: Understand customer concerns and respond with care, patience, and respect. ● Problem\-Solving Mindset: Take ownership of customer issues and actively work towards finding solutions. ● Brand Sensitivity \& Discretion: Handle intimatewear\-related queries and customer information with professionalism, sensitivity, and confidentiality. ● Attention to Detail: Ensure accuracy in order information, shipment tracking, returns, refunds, and reporting. ● Communication Skills: Communicate clearly and professionally across calls, emails, WhatsApp, chat, and social media. ● Follow\-up \& Ownership: Ensure customer concerns are followed up on and resolved within the agreed timelines. ● Teamwork: Coordinate effectively with warehouse, logistics, marketplace, and internal e\-commerce teams.

What You Can Expect

● An opportunity to work with an established homegrown brand with an 87\-year legacy. ● Exposure to e\-commerce customer experience, order management, logistics, and marketplace operations. ● Opportunities to learn Shopify, Unicommerce, and other e\-commerce tools. ● A collaborative work environment with opportunities for learning and growth.

description:
**Job title:** Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** Manager, IT Systems Administration**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time**Schedule:** Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests

 **Purpose of the Role**
Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.  

While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus. **Your Key Responsibilities:****Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends

**Cloud Security**

* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments

**Cloud Networking**

* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures

**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**

* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed

**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**

* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments

**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**

* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records

 **What You’ll Need:****Minimum:*** 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.

 **Your Advantage:*** Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

Strong expertise in Windows Server administration.


Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.

Experience in troubleshooting complex enterprise infrastructure issues.

ITIL Foundation

title: Salesforce Quality Analyst
description:

### **Location: Coimbatore**

  

  

### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Salesforce Quality Analyst** with 3\+ years of experience in software testing and strong expertise in **Salesforce application testing**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality, performance, and reliability of Salesforce solutions across implementation, enhancement, integration, and data migration projects.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze **Salesforce requirements, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria** to create detailed test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
* Perform functional and regression testing across Salesforce applications, including **Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and customized Salesforce solutions**.
* Develop and execute **manual and automated test cases** for Salesforce applications.
* Validate Salesforce configurations, including **Objects, Fields, Validation Rules, Workflows/Flows, Approval Processes, Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, and Reports**.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using tools such as **Jira and** **Monday.com**.
* Collaborate with **Salesforce Developers, Consultants, Business Analysts, and stakeholders** to investigate and resolve defects.
* Perform **regression testing** for Salesforce enhancements, fixes, releases, and deployments.
* Conduct **API and integration testing** to validate data exchange between Salesforce and external systems.
* Perform **Salesforce data migration testing**, including data validation, data integrity, field mapping, and record reconciliation.
* Validate business processes and end\-to\-end workflows across Salesforce and integrated applications.
* Perform **UAT support** and assist business stakeholders in validating Salesforce solutions against business requirements.
* Monitor and maintain defect logs while performing **root\-cause analysis** for recurring issues.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with **Salesforce release and deployment cycles**.
* Stay updated with Salesforce platform features, testing tools, QA methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of **Salesforce QA processes, test automation, and testing methodologies**.
  

  

### **Qualifications**


* **3\+ years of proven experience in Quality Assurance / Software Testing**, preferably with significant experience in Salesforce testing.
* Hands\-on experience in **Salesforce application testing**.
* Strong knowledge of **manual testing and automation testing**.
* Good understanding of Salesforce configuration and business processes.
* Experience testing **Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud** or similar Salesforce implementations.
* Strong understanding of **functional, integration, regression, system, and UAT testing**.
* Experience with **API testing tools and methodologies**.
* Experience in **Salesforce data migration testing and data validation**.
* Familiarity with **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Experience with defect management tools such as **Jira,** **Monday.com****, or similar platforms**.
* Strong understanding of test case design, test execution, defect lifecycle, and test result analysis.

### **Preferred Skills**


* Experience working on **Salesforce implementation and customization projects**.
* Knowledge of **Salesforce Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, and Reports** from a testing perspective.
* Familiarity with **Salesforce APIs, integrations, and external system interfaces**.
* Experience with **Salesforce deployment and release testing**.
* Knowledge of Salesforce\-specific test automation tools or frameworks.
* Salesforce certification such as **Salesforce Certified Administrator** or relevant QA certification is an added advantage.

### **Preferred Attributes**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to understand complex Salesforce business processes.
* Strong defect investigation and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work closely with **Salesforce Developers, Consultants, Business Analysts, and clients**.
